title: draw_bundles header still teaches the superseded 3.3 three-lane-stripe canon as current law
detail: The function's doc block asserts the exact canon this PR removes (three WFQ lane strokes on every pipe, band_width ribbon), contradicting the laneless ruling at the hottest render site.
recommended_fix: Rewrite the draw_bundles doc block to the LOOK §3 laneless ruling (single covenant-capped stroke, hue carries tier); mark the 3.3 lane canon superseded like the lane_detail removal.

title: band_width has zero callers after the diff; its ONE-definition doc now names consumers that no longer use it
detail: Repo-wide grep finds no call site left: draw_bundles, draw_selection, crisis outlines, assist glow, and riders all migrated to link_width_capped/link_width_world. Dead proc with a doc claiming live consumers.
recommended_fix: Delete band_width (and its doc) or wire the one intended endpoint-blind caller; a dead 'ONE definition' invites a restated copy.

title: node_draw_size_world restates the existing node_sprite_radius_world derivation and diverges in the fallback branch
detail: Same endpoint-size derivation exists twice (×2 semantics: full width vs rim radius); in the primitive-fallback mode the covenant cap uses sprite math while nodes draw primitive footprints, so the cap and the drawn nodes diverge.
recommended_fix: Derive node_draw_size_world from node_sprite_radius_world (×2, one shared helper) or add the matching !sprites.ok fallback, so cap and footprint cannot drift.

title: Dusk dot radius doc says per-building footprint but draw_dusk_dot uses the house footprint for biz/campus
detail: small_biz/campus get DUSK_DOT_HOUSE_F × the house target, not their own 1.10/1.22 targets, so the halo proportion differs per role (≈74% of campus width); the comment and the PR's footprint claim overstate it.
recommended_fix: Either select the footprint per role (sprite_small_biz_target/sprite_campus_target) or reword the comment to 'house footprint (DC excepted)'.

title: count_exact's doc comment stranded above the newly inserted measure_color_run
detail: The insertion landed between count_exact and its comment: measure_color_run opens with a mismatched doc, and count_exact (below) is left undocumented.
recommended_fix: Move the count_exact comment back onto count_exact, leaving only the measure_color_run doc above the new proc.
